title: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses

entities.name: Elspeth Calderwood
entities.description: A planeswalker and warrior who carries the Halo and fights alongside the strike team, riding down with Mirran cart operators.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker and Mirran Resistance leader who guides the team through the Dross Pits and who escaped Sheoldred's Coliseum once.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A lithomancer planeswalker whose Phyrexian infection spreads as she shatters the coliseum into the Fair Basilica.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker trained as the backup sylex operator, who phases through obstacles and takes the sylex pack from Jace.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker from Kamigawa who fights with a throwing-star sword and tanuki drone.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker who borrows the nature of Glimmervoid metal to turn his skin metallic.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker and the primary sylex operator who rushes to Vraska's call, is infected by her, and must still carry the sylex.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran healer immune to phyresis who cannot cure Jace on the spot.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Jace's lover who is mortally infected in Sheoldred's Coliseum and betrays Jace with a Phyrexian tail.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A winged Phyrexian angel fighting to hold Elesh Norn's domain.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader of the Fair Basilica, whose altar the team approaches.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor leading a rebellion against Norn's Phyrexia.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian thane who runs the coliseum for her amusement and has joined Urabrask's rebellion.

entities.name: Thrissik
entities.description: A Phyrexian thane who builds cairns to bring about his Destroyer.

entities.name: Roxith
entities.description: One of the thanes who sided with Urabrask.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: One of the thanes who sided with Urabrask.

entities.name: Vraan
entities.description: One of the thanes who sided with Urabrask.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian who moved the Tangle beneath the surface as the seed of his empire.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Kaito's tanuki drone, which beeps a warning in combat.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane the strike team is invading.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane Phyrexia took and layered into New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane that Jace conjures as an illusion for Vraska.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: A layer of rotting necrogen pools ruled by seven thanes.

entities.name: Sheoldred's Coliseum
entities.description: A gutted bowl built beneath a ribcage where Sheoldred makes Phyrexians and captured Mirrans fight.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: Elesh Norn's silver-and-white domain, into which the coliseum is dropped.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: The layer built from the old Tangle that the team bypasses.

entities.name: Surgical Bay
entities.description: A layer of fountains whose spray can start phyresis.

entities.name: Necrogen
entities.description: Glowing green liquid that can transmute the unwary into undead or induce phyresis.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A bottled remedy that protects against necrogen in the air for a while.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: The bomb meant to destroy the World Tree, carried in a pack by Jace and then Kaya.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde of New Phyrexia, partly in civil war between Norn and Urabrask.

entities.name: The Resistance
entities.description: Mirran fighters, including cart operators and Koth's demolition team, who join the descent.

entities.name: Urabrask's rebellion
entities.description: A Phyrexian civil war against Elesh Norn's rule that distracts forces in the Dross Pits.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: The process of Phyrexian infection by glistening oil.

events.summary: The carts plunge down the tunnel and Elspeth chats with the Mirran operators about the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay the team is bypassing.
events.quote: Vorinclex transported the worst of it beneath the surface during the great transformation

events.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
events.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

events.summary: Koth explains the thanes of the Dross Pits, four of whom support Urabrask's rebellion, so the team can use the chaos for cover.
events.quote: Seven thanes rule the Dross Pits, but they've never been united.

events.summary: Elspeth distributes Halo, and Jace collapses after drinking his dose.
events.quote: the bottle slipping from his fingers before he collapsed backward onto the cart behind him

events.summary: Jace wakes and tries to run off, saying Vraska is in pain and calling to him.
events.quote: She made it down here, and she's alone and she's scared.

events.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
events.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

events.summary: Jace uses illusions so that Phyrexians locked in civil war cannot see the group as they cross the battlefield.
events.quote: When they look at us, they see nothing at all,

events.summary: Koth identifies Sheoldred's Coliseum and reveals that he once escaped it.
events.quote: No one exits the coliseum alive and unchanged. I escaped. Mostly.

events.summary: Jace runs into the coliseum and the others follow; Kaito wants to recover the sylex, but Elspeth insists on saving their own.
events.quote: What's the value of fighting at all, if we can't even make the stand to save our own?

events.summary: The group finds Vraska, gravely wounded and surrounded by Phyrexians.
events.quote: bleeding profusely from a dozen terrible wounds, stood Vraska.

events.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
events.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

events.summary: Vraska tells Jace she is already infected and begs him to flee, saying she loves him.
events.quote: Run, Jace Beleren, and don't look back.

events.summary: Nahiri slices Jace's pack straps and Kaya snatches the sylex; the group leaves Jace and Vraska behind.
events.quote: Nahiri snapped her fingers.

events.summary: Jace casts an illusion of a sunny Ravnican avenue so that he and Vraska can spend one more day together.
events.quote: The coliseum was gone, replaced by a sundrenched Ravnican avenue

events.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
events.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

events.summary: Vraska reveals Jace is also infected and kisses him as the illusion ends.
events.quote: You're as doomed as I am.

events.summary: Vraska, now loyal to Phyrexia, stabs Jace's hand with a scorpion-like tail dosing him with oil, and Jace flees.
events.quote: For the glory of Phyrexia,

events.summary: Nahiri exposes her infected neck and declares she will move the mission forward by force.
events.quote: The mission only goes forward if we move on .

events.summary: Nahiri, her infection spreading, cleaves the layer and drops the coliseum into the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: And then, with a vast and terrible shattering, she did precisely that, and everything fell into darkness.

events.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
events.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

events.summary: Atraxa appears fighting Phyrexian invaders above the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: the gleaming, wide-winged form of Atraxa

events.summary: Jace, burned by Vraska's venom, asks for the sylex back, and Melira cannot heal him here.
events.quote: I'm not going to survive this as it stands, I may as well be the one to trigger the blast.

events.summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
events.quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms
